markets.question: Will HYPE Singapore go ahead on 6–7 October?
markets.resolves: YES if Hype Global republishes an event page or the hackathon and conference take place in Singapore on 6–7 October. NO if it is cancelled or moved.

markets.question: Will Shayne Coplan mention the US midterms in his TOKEN2049 fireside?
markets.resolves: YES if the words “midterms” or “midterm elections” are said during the Polymarket fireside on Wed 7 October, per the official recording.

markets.question: Will it rain at Marina Bay during the day on Wednesday 7 October?
markets.resolves: YES if Singapore’s Meteorological Service records any rainfall at the Marina Barrage station between 08:00 and 20:00 SGT on Wed 7 October.

markets.question: Will TOKEN2049 Singapore report more than 25,000 attendees?
markets.resolves: YES if TOKEN2049’s own post-event figure for Singapore 2026 is above 25,000 attendees.

markets.question: Will this guide list 60 or more events by Monday 5 October?
markets.resolves: YES if the Events directory on this site shows 60 or more events at 09:00 SGT on Mon 5 October.

markets.question: Will Hyperliquid announce a new HIP-4 outcome-market deployment during TOKEN2049 week?
markets.resolves: YES if Hyperliquid’s official channels announce a new HIP-4 outcome market or deployment between Mon 5 and Fri 9 October (SGT).

markets.question: Will Predict.fun announce a new partnership during TOKEN2049 week?
markets.resolves: YES if Predict.fun’s official X account or blog announces a new named partner between Mon 5 and Fri 9 October (SGT).

markets.question: Will Singapore hit 33°C on Thursday 8 October?
markets.resolves: YES if Singapore’s Meteorological Service records a maximum of 33.0°C or higher at Changi on Thu 8 October.

markets.question: Will AFTER2049 tickets sell out before Friday 9 October?
markets.resolves: YES if the official Megatix page shows AFTER2049 as sold out before 00:00 SGT on Fri 9 October.

markets.question: Will Who’s going list 150 or more people and companies by Monday 5 October?
markets.resolves: YES if the Who’s going page on this site shows 150 or more people and companies at 09:00 SGT on Mon 5 October.
